get.summary: Gets all recipient field definitions for a user for a specified currency and a country.
get.description:
Sample request:
            
    GET /recipients/fields/AU/GBP
            
\
Required user rights:
            
    CanAccessRecipients
            
\
<details><summary>**Names and descriptions for the fields that can be returned**</summary>
*   ibanOrAccountNumber - Used if either an IBAN, or an domestic Account Number can be provided.
*   accountNumber - Account Number (Domestic - with respect to the Bank Address Country Code) for the recipient's bank account.
*   iban - International Bank Account Number for the recipient's bank account.
*   nationalClearingCode - National Clearing Code for the recipient's bank.
*   bankAccountType - The type of bank account. (NOTE: is looking for an integer value that should map to the values stored for each type, e.g. 10 for Savings)
*   bankBic - Bank Identification Code for the recipient's bank.
*   bankName - Name of the bank for the recipient's account.
*   bankAddressLine1 - Line 1 of the address for the recipient's bank.
*   bankAddressLine2 - Line 2 of the address for the recipient's bank.
*   bankAddressLine3 - Line 3 of the address for the recipient's bank.
*   bankAddressCountryCode - Country code for the recipient's bank.
*   accountName - Name of the recipient on their bank account.
*   email -  Email for the recipient.
*   addressLine1 - Line 1 of the address for the recipient.
*   addressLine2 - Line 2 of the address for the recipient.
*   addressCountryCode - Country code of the address for the recipient.
*   paymentReference - Client specified reference when making payments to the recipient.
*   intermediaryBankNationalClearingCode - National Clearing Code for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankBic - Bank Identification Code for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankName - Name of the intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankIbanOrAccountNumber - IBAN or Account Number for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankAddressLine1 - Line 1 of the address for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankAddressLine2 - Line 2 of the address for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankAddressLine3 - Line 3 of the address for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankAddressCountryCode - Country code for an intermediary bank.
*   purposeOfPaymentCode - Default purpose of payment code for the recipient.
*   purposeOfPaymentFreeText - Default purpose of payment free text for the recipient.
*   nickname - Nickname specified by the client.
</details>

CreateQuoteRequest.description:
Request body for creating a new quote. Quotes expire in around 15 seconds.

SWIFT characters match the following regular expression: ^[\r\n\sa-zA-Z0-9\/\-:,'\?\(\)\.\+]*$
            
"buyCurrency" - Code of the currency being converted to.
"sellCurrency" - Code of the currency provided by the client.
"buyOrSell" - 'Buy' or 'Sell': Whether the client is buying or selling the amount of currency.
"amount" - Amount of the currency being bought or sold.
"recipientId" - Optional: ID of the recipient to make the payment to. Note that this is required for a contract to be updated, so if not provided on creation then the quote will need updating to contain it.
"reference" - Optional: Reference for the recipient to identify a transfer. SWIFT characters only.
"purposeOfPaymentCode" - Optional: Code for the reason why the client is making the transfer. Cannot be an empty string, if provided. Note that this is required for a contract to be updated, so if not provided on creation then the quote will need updating to contain it.
"purposeOfPaymentFreeText" - Optional: If allowed for the code, the client can enter their reason for the transfer in text form. SWIFT characters only.
"recipientEmailAddress" - Optional: Email address that will be notified when the payment is made.
"privateReference" - Optional: Private reference for the client to identify a transfer. SWIFT characters only.
"valueDate" - Optional: yyyy-MM-dd - Effective date of the transfer.

Quote.description:
Details for a quote.
            
"quoteId" - ID of the quote.
"quoteStatus" - Enum value for the status of the quote.
"quoteStatusText" - Text value for the status of the quote.
"expiryTimeMilliseconds" - Amount of time until the quote expires.
"buyCurrency" - Code of the currency being converted to.
"sellCurrency" - Code of the currency provided by the client.
"baseCurrency" - Code of the base currency for the currency pair.
"rate" - Quoted exchange rate of base currency to the other currency.
"inverseRate" - Inverse quoted exchange rate of the currency pair.
"rateMovement" - Whether the rate is better or worse than the previous rate for this quote.
"buyOrSell" - Whether the client is buying or selling the amount of currency.
"buyAmount" - Amount of money for the buy currency.
"sellAmount" - Amount of money for the sell currency.
"fees" - Total fees for the transfer of the specified currencies.
"settlementAmount" - Total cost to the client, including fees.
"balanceAmount" - Amount of money the client has left to pay for the contract.
"balanceDueDate" - yyyy-MM-dd: Date by which the contract balance is to be paid by the client.
"securityDeposit" - Amount of money the client has to pay for the security deposit.
"securityDepositDueDate" - Date by which the security deposit is to be paid by the client. This will be confirmed when the contract is created.
"valueDate" - yyyy-MM-dd: Effective date of the transfer.
"availableDate" - yyyy-MM-dd: Date the contract proceeds should be available (received) by the recipient.

quoteStatus.description:
0 = NotSet
1 = Error
2 = Quoted
3 = PollRequired
4 = FailedValidation
5 = InvalidQuoteId
6 = Timeout
7 = Validated

UpdateQuoteRequest.description:

SWIFT characters match the following regular expression: ^[\r\n\sa-zA-Z0-9\/\-:,'\?\(\)\.\+]*$
            
"amount" - Optional: Amount of the currency being bought or sold.
"recipientId" - Optional: ID of the recipient to make the payment to.
"reference" - Optional: Reference for the recipient to identify a transaction. Note that this is required for a contract to be updated, so if not provided on creation then the quote will need updating to contain it. SWIFT characters only.
"purposeOfPaymentCode" - Optional: Code for the reason why the client is making the transfer. Cannot be an empty string, if provided. Note that this is required for a contract to be updated, so if not provided on creation then the quote will need updating to contain it.
"purposeOfPaymentFreeText" - Optional: If allowed for the code, the client can enter their reason for the transfer in text form. SWIFT characters only.
"recipientEmailAddress" - Optional: Email address that will be notified when the payment is made.
"privateReference" - Optional: Private reference for the client to identify a transfer. SWIFT characters only.
"valueDate" - Optional: yyyy-MM-dd - Effective date of the transfer.
